title: Room Temperature Sensor Fault

title: Whirlpool F0 — Indoor/Outdoor Communication Error
shortDescription: Whirlpool Air Conditioner error F0: The indoor and outdoor units cannot communicate over the inter-unit signal line.
fullDescription: Error code F0 on Whirlpool air conditioners indicates the indoor and outdoor units cannot communicate over the inter-unit signal line. This condition normally locks out cooling or heating until the fault is cleared. Common causes include a defective communication wire/PCB, a loose or damaged wiring harness between the component and the main control board, or a failure of the control board itself. Begin with a hard power reset, then inspect the communication wire/PCB and its wiring before considering board replacement.
symptoms: F0 shown on the indoor display or remote
Compressor or fan does not start

fixSteps.title: Power reset
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect the unit from power for 5 minutes, then restore power and observe whether the error returns.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Open the service panel and verify all connectors at the main control board are fully seated and undamaged.

fixSteps.title: Test the suspect component
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter to verify resistance or continuity of the affected sensor or component, and compare against service manual specs.

fixSteps.title: Replace the failed part
fixSteps.instruction: Order the matching replacement part for your model, install it in the same orientation, and reconnect all wiring before re-testing.

whenToCallPro: If basic checks do not clear the F0 code, an HVAC technician should be called to verify refrigerant pressures and inverter operation.
